basis: Sweep-only comparison arm: two instances x tensor-parallel 4 on host A800I-03 (ssh npu2), measured against the 4xtp2 profile by the synthetic concurrency sweep (owner decision 2026-10-28). max_num_seqs 32 is a PLACEHOLDER ceiling. cpusets pin each instance to its own cards' PCI NUMA node(s) read on 181 (2026-10-28: NPU 0-1 node 6 = 192-223, 2-3 node 4 = 128-159, 4-5 node 0 = 0-31, 6-7 node 2 = 64-95; 32 cores per node). The other 128 cores (nodes 1/3/5/7) stay free for the flight harness and CPU encoder runs on the same host.
